doc.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997

title: Closing thanks and the Chautauqua festival
summary: Rowe thanks him; Collins says he enjoys festivals and will play with Michael Moore.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well those are good words of wisdom. Well it’s been a pleasure talking to you.
And I hope you have a great night tonight and tomorrow.
Going to. I’ve never played a festival of any kind, anywhere in the world, that I didn’t have a ball. It’s just really fun. Everybody gets together and has a good time.
Plus your old pal Michael Moore will be with you.
